newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dharmala sells Philippines unit stake.
newsitem.headline: Dharmala sells Philippines unit stake.

text.p: Dharmala Holdings Ltd said on Friday its 71 percent owned Dharmala Philippines Inc agreed to sell its entire 50 percent stake in Bush Boake Allen Philippines Inc (BBAP) in two tranches for HK$59.30 million.

Dharmala Philippines has agreed to sell both tranches of its stake in BBAP to third party A. Boake, Roberts and Company (Holdings) Ltd, which already owns 50 percent of the fragrances and flavours manufacturer, it said.
The first tranche of 24.2 percent would be sold for HK$28.70 million, it said. No date was given for the sale.
The second tranche of 25.8 percent would be sold for HK$30.60 million and was expected to take place on January 8, Dharmala Holdings said.
